Two specialists, one clinic

Walk in for your eyes or your pain. Each department has its own doctor and its own hours.

Dr. Shrikant Singh

Ophthalmologist, eye care

Checks your vision, finds the cause of the problem and plans treatment, from glasses and contact lenses to surgery.

Dr. Pratibha Singh

Pain physician, Pain OPD

Treats long-lasting pain, including PRP therapy. Pain OPD runs Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM to 6:30 PM.

What we treat

Eye care

  • Complete eye examination
  • Cataract treatment and surgery
  • Diabetic eye (retinopathy) care
  • Uveitis management
  • Squint treatment and squint surgery
  • Contact lens prescriptions

Pain clinic

  • Chronic pain consultation
  • Platelet-rich plasma (PRP) therapy
  • Joint and nerve pain evaluation

Care you can afford

Ayushman Bharat accepted Free cataract surgery programme

Free cataract surgery with modern lenses is offered together with the Drishti Virendra Sarjami Seva Trust. Eligibility rules apply, so call the clinic to check whether you qualify and what to bring.

Your visit, step by step

  1. Call or request a callback. Reception gives you a date and time.
  2. Register at the clinic. Show your Ayushman Bharat card if you are using the scheme.
  3. Examination. Eye patients see Dr. Shrikant Singh. Pain patients see Dr. Pratibha Singh in Pain OPD hours.
  4. Treatment. Medicines, a day-care procedure such as PRP, or a surgery date.
  5. Billing and instructions. Collect your prescription and aftercare advice.
